name: led-12ma
prompt: Build an indicator: a single red LED running at approximately 12 mA from a 12 V supply, with a correctly sized series resistor.
notes: One resistor, one LED, one arithmetic step: R = (12 - Vf) / 0.012 with Vf around 2 V gives roughly 830 ohms (E24: 820). A 330-ohm reflex answer runs the LED at 30 mA.
